audit.why: HARD 8/10 lane framing is right: 1050-range stun, 750 Q, artillery zoning vs a 750-range walk-up mage. The 55.04% WR with a 7/7 Xerath chart is not a contradiction — prose consistently frames it as lose-lane-win-game via roams and teamfight R, and the two chart layers already agree.
Spikes are coherent: his 3-5 zoning window, his 6 (R snipes), his 1st item (poke scales), Swain's value arriving only in 5v5s. Both chart layers agree on all seven rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nowhere did the page state that Xerath's R Rite of the Arcane is a self-immobilizing channel that Swain's E cancels; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Kit: R 'immobilizes himself', channel flag set, matches description; E Shocking Orb 13s rank 1; Q 9s/80 mana.
audit.corrected: Channel-cancel written into spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers; bleed bullets rewritten to their titles.

edits.before: R Rite of the Arcane lets him snipe you from screens away and you have no way to reach him with your own R — respect the artillery and play for roams instead of the 1v1.
edits.after: R Rite of the Arcane snipes you from screens away, but it roots him in place to channel — inside your 850-range E, Nevermove cancels it outright. Otherwise play for roams.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Nevermove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): his only CC, 13s at rank 1 — dodge it and the artillery never converts into a kill; its downtime is your step-up. - Q Arcanopulse is 9s and 80 mana early — dodges bleed him dry. - His R self-roots to channel: your E cancels it.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Vision of Empire outranges his whole kit at 5500+ units — once a root connects, tag his retreat with W and the Q follow-up cannot miss.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: At half HP one Shocking Orb into W-Q artillery kills you from beyond your own vision — reset before the stun threat exists.

notes: Packet defect 'chart contradicts 55.04% WR' judged NOT a real defect: WR is game winrate and the page explicitly frames this as lose-lane, win-game (roams, teamfight R); both chart layers already agree 7/7 Xerath, so no chart edits. sectionsMissing (templated but not grounded without desyncing the tradeGood/tradeBad set that is also embedded in breakdown.trading and report[3].t): tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late.
